description: Synthetic evaluation catalog and one viewer account (Dana Marsh, US) covering 2025-01-01 through 2026-12-31 (America/Los_Angeles): the fixture catalog and account with one review or synopsis text per record, plus parental-guide updates, new seasons, public reviews to Dec. 30, 2026, and two years of alerts, corrections, notices and lists. Dana's history ends at the fixture clock (2026-12-01 09:00 -08:00). Loadable with env.load_seed at any clock in the window; Kinodex shows only the records that exist at the clock. The account settings, watchlist and lists are current state, stored as of their last change and not rewound, so the dataset reads exactly as stored from 2026-11-15T20:10:00Z (generation.parameters.current_state_valid_from); a Task that starts earlier supplies its own watchlist, list and settings state. expected_counts.records counts titles (plugin.records).

sources.description: Original fictional text authored for this package by @byshail. All titles, people, services, prices, reviews and guide text are invented; no external film, TV, streaming or review data were collected, translated or adapted.

Template-generated fictional review texts, episode synopses, guide updates, seasons and account history written by dev/build-dataset.cjs from the fixture's titles, people and word lists. All titles, people, services and reviews are invented; nothing was collected from real websites.

transformations: Every fixture record is kept with its ID, dates, ratings and flags. Public review texts (except rv-lh-01), Dana's diary review texts (except her Wrenfield Clock review) and the synopses of the generated series' episodes are rewritten, one text per record, because the fixture draws them from short phrase lists; repeated episode names within a series are renamed.

Added records: guide versions, two seasons with their episodes, public reviews from 2026-10-15 to 2026-12-30, and Dana's alerts, corrections, notices and lists. Alert triggers, decision notices and guide versions are written as the App's events would write them.

Added US rental and purchase windows before the fixture's own offers (313 offers, from a separate random stream): each opens at the title's digital release (45 days after the US release) or, for older titles, between January 2023 and August 2024, and closes when the fixture's first US rental or purchase opens, or in October or early November 2026. Every diary entry is then watchable in the US on its date or falls within 60 days of the US release (checked). The windows close before the dataset clock and before any seeded rule could match them (checked).

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation, name collisions and reuse permissions.
